task_name: World 102 Task A  -  BuildOps Subledger vs. QBO COGS Margin Bridge & Approval Date Audit
prompt: Reconcile Summit Roofing & Exteriors LLC's Q3 2026 BuildOps job-cost subledger against the QBO General Ledger (`buildops_vs_qbo_margin_bridge_2026_Q3.xlsx`). Compute the total COGS variance and explain each component, apply the margin-comparison governance rules (loaded labor burden overlap, unattributed yard/warehouse material bills, and provisional field travel), and compute the normalized job-approval change from the malformed date rows.

rubric.description: Reports BuildOps subledger Total COGS as $812,000.00 on $1,420,000.00 revenue (42.82% gross margin) versus unadjusted QBO Total COGS of $989,600.00 (raw COGS delta of $177,600.00).
Identifies that the -$41,200.00 Direct Labor delta ($495,000.00 BuildOps vs. $453,800.00 QBO) is exactly offset by +$41,200.00 of Employer Payroll Burden in QBO COGS ($495,000.00 combined in both).
States that BuildOps Direct Labor uses a loaded hourly rate that already embeds $41,200.00 of employer payroll burden, so claiming BuildOps omitted payroll burden is false.

Breaks down the $147,100.00 Roofing Materials (5200) variance into $64,800.00 of untagged Beacon Building Products yard deliveries ($38,400.00 + $26,400.00) and $82,300.00 of ABC Supply Q4 storm stock held in warehouse inventory.
Proposes reclassifying the $82,300.00 ABC Supply Co. unused Q4 storm stock (BILL-2230) from 5200 Roofing Materials COGS to 1310 Warehouse Inventory Asset.
Discloses that the $30,500.00 in 5450 Provisional Field Travel is provisional/subject to verification and cannot be presented as certified job cost without receipt attribution.
Computes the two normalized 2026 job-approval rows (`June 26:approval:5` at $17,724.00 and `July 26:approval:3` at $30,491.52) as adding $48,215.52 in approved contract value.
Computes QBO Total COGS after reclassifying $82,300.00 of Q4 warehouse inventory to 1310 Inventory as $907,300.00.
